resolution: This profile replaces activation/consumption below; inherited question text, criteria, types and method meaning remain verbatim. It does not merge old free-LLM policy. No new question family.

shared_prerequisite.input_admitted: Original documents directly bound OR material generated proposal passed current fidelity review; relevant scope/identity/authority known. G01 is required for a newly generated load-bearing proposal, not fabricated for raw input.
shared_prerequisite.substitution: Replace inherited G01=faithful consumption prerequisite with input_admitted. Still require G01 for generated load-bearing representations. Retain all other explicit question prerequisites unless individually overridden below.
shared_prerequisite.non_ok: Mark only the dependent scope unresolved; it is not false, 0, or a passed route. Preserve original text and successful independent work.
shared_prerequisite.existing_resolution: For omitted conditional questions, an already resolved handling-mode/scope/assessability/companion condition may satisfy the semantic prerequisite only with its source, responsible owner and current version. Record condition_source=existing_resolution, never fabricate a Jev observation. Missing resolution stays unresolved. S01 positive is replaced by assessability established under this rule or actual S01.

activation.M02: Required retained issue-method candidates after full canonical contract is available; skip direct task.
activation.M03: Same State as M02, current real handling context; proposed labels are not expected truths.
activation.S02: Multiple unresolved issues or materially depth-changing consequences; use known assessability or S01; no mandatory score for simple tasks.
activation.G01: New/changed load-bearing semantic representation; absent for direct original text view.
activation.G02: Genuine multi-issue coverage uncertainty; not duplicated with V01 at same join.
activation.G03: Semantic handling-mode uncertainty; known direct work bypasses.
activation.G04: Specific dispute about obligation scope, not every defect.
activation.G05: A mentioned method has invocation/review/incidental ambiguity.
activation.M01: Candidate discovery only when complete contracts absent.
activation.M04: M02 nonpositive or actual role/entry conflict requiring gap localization.
activation.M05: Known canonical companion trigger unclear; established triggers directly enforced without repeated inference.
activation.R01: Actual output/coverage reuse requires validity for the specified use.
activation.R03: Same-scope competition with both applicable; may speculate in same batch, consume only if premise holds.
activation.R04: A proposed concrete producer-output-consumer dependency exists; no all-pairs expansion.
activation.S01: Assessability of S02 genuinely unknown; known consequence information reused.
activation.V01: New plan or genuine uncovered-issue signal.
activation.V02: Specific duplication/re-analysis signal in an actual plan.
activation.V03: Specific cross-scope/authority/evidence use risk in an actual plan.

M02.negative: do_not_start_this_method; local M04 only when helpful
M02.unresolved: local exception or acquire; no full-route veto

M03.primary_candidate: Commit if sole eligible primary in this scope; otherwise canonical arbitration or R03.
M03.support: Commit support scope when M02 positive.
M03.constraint: Commit domain constraint role; no new permissions.
M03.support_and_constraint: One method step carries both, not two executions.
M03.covered: Only omit/reuse if effective artifact or explicit adequate current responsibility established; otherwise unresolved.
M03.no_contribution: Do not start; preserve required reads and actual explicit request disposition.
M03.unclear: Local unresolved exception; not a silent alternative primary.

R03.left: Commit left primary for shared scope. Losing primary becomes not_selected_as_primary, NOT automatically support; preserve separately established required support/constraints.
R03.unclear: One scoped arbitration; no majority voting

R04.none: No semantic edge; resource/authority constraints remain.
R04.needed_to_begin: Consumer starts only after required output accepted for that use.
R04.needed_before_commit: Independent preparation allowed, dependent commitment waits.
R04.conditional: Require actual named condition evidence; unknown freezes that dependent commitment.

S02.assessable: Carry value and native distribution as attention guidance to method executor; no weighted route winner or uncalibrated hard depth gate.
S02.not_assessable: retain raw observation, not consumed; impact unknown
S02.conflict: Authority, dependencies, user bounds, required checks dominate.

draft_numeric_policy.purpose: low-risk reversible opt-in development only, no production calibration claim
draft_numeric_policy.choice: valid category; explicit unclear/non-ok or relevant cross-result conflict -> scoped unresolved

objection.receipt: Separate bounded context only on exception, cites original sources; code validates identity/scope/permissions, never validity of semantics by syntax alone.

correction.component: existing relationship module; no hardcoded Skills/display IDs
correction.when: named frame/candidate defect at before-route or before-answer
correction.action: one real bounded correction or same objection channel, not ignorable diagnostic

limits.dual_role_call: one actual request; debit each declared role slot
limits.method_execution: original mission budget, count all end-to-end costs

acceptance: acceptance.md; engineering and small paired usable-task validation; old cases are exposed development, no universal accuracy claim
